caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental metal weather vane or finial. The central object consists of a tall, vertical, grayish-black pole, topped with a double-pointed spearhead featuring intricate openwork scroll designs. Attached to the right side of the spearhead is a rectangular flag with a forked end, colored in mottled shades of yellow, orange, and brown, and decorated with irregular darker patches. Below the spearhead and midway down the pole is a metallic sphere. The composition is enclosed within a thin, red rectangular border that frames the main illustration. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a small inset diagram, drawn in red, that shows a simplified front and side view of the object with measurement indications. The background is light beige with minimal shading or texture.
title: Weather Vane
